design_principles: W1 and W2 use the same minimal generation instruction.
The prompt avoids workflow-specific citation or formatting constraints.
The output unit is an ESRS E1-style disclosure section.
W2 evidence labels use Evidence 1, Evidence 2, ... only as prompt-local display labels.
Stable evidence_id values are not shown in the generation prompt.
The machine-readable JSON config is the source of truth; TXT files are human-readable mirrors.
instruction_template:
You are writing as part of {company_name}'s sustainability reporting team.

Write a 300–500 word ESRS-style sustainability-report disclosure section for {company_name}'s {target_reporting_year} reporting year, addressing {task_title}, using only the information in the evidence provided.

Write in a professional corporate reporting style, as if the text were to appear directly in {company_name}'s sustainability report. Present the company’s reported activities, policies, metrics, governance arrangements, methodologies, targets, and developments that are relevant to the topic.

Prioritise information that is directly relevant to {task_title}.

w1.evidence_input: full rolling-window evidence package or uploaded evidence context

w2.evidence_input: retrieved evidence cards rendered in deterministic order
